# FOX 5 Atlanta

> FOX 5 Atlanta delivers breaking news, weather forecasts, sports coverage, and live streaming for the Atlanta metro and north Georgia region.

FOX 5 Atlanta is the primary news source for Atlanta and surrounding areas, offering comprehensive coverage across multiple platforms including mobile apps, live streaming, and broadcast television. The station covers local news, weather, sports (Braves, Falcons, Hawks), and features popular shows like Good Day Atlanta and High 5 Sports.

## Breaking News & Live Coverage

- [News | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/news): Atlanta breaking news from metro Atlanta and north Georgia coverage
- [Live News Stream: Watch FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/live): Stream live news and weather from FOX 5 Atlanta with multi-platform access
- [Local News | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/local-news): Local news from Atlanta metro and Georgia counties including Fulton DeKalb

## Weather & Storm Tracking

- [Weather | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/weather): Atlanta weather forecasts and current conditions from FOX 5 meteorologists
- [Download the FOX 5 Storm Team app | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/storm): FOX 5 Storm Team weather app for storm tracking and weather alerts

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/sports): Atlanta sports coverage of Braves, Falcons, Hawks and local teams
- [High 5 Sports | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/shows/high-5-sports): High 5 Sports high school football coverage and highlights from Atlanta area

## Shows & Programming

- [Good Day Atlanta | FOX 5 Atlanta](https://www.fox5atlanta.com/shows/good-day-atlanta): Good Day Atlanta morning show with news, weather and entertainment segments
